name: E5_reliability_cost
title: Reliability statistics of the input-referred bound errors of the E4 forests, errors of the drift compensation itself (replica sampling, gain error, DAC resolution) and time to an error budget

reuse.note: imported unchanged: CellModel, theta_effs, pcm_states, forest_state, eval_points, Instrument; every bound is the E4 bound of the same forest, Monte Carlo instance and PCM draw

error: e = 15 (theta_eff - theta) in LSB of the 4-bit threshold (1 LSB = 1/15 of the normalized input); theta_eff from the E4 CellModel
extreme: |e| > 15 LSB: bound failure (PCM conductance at 0 after noise, x_eff = -10 by the E4 convention); counted as exceeding every budget; rms reported with and without them; excluded from added-error statistics

e51.points: the E4 evaluation points: t0 (programming noise only) and 1d, 30d, 1y x {dac_remap, supply, ideal}
e51.percentile_method: numpy.percentile (linear) of |e| over all bounds of a key, bound failures included

spot.role: independent re-check 1: counts of |e| > 0.5 and > 1 LSB

e52.rng: numpy.random.default_rng([base_seed, ds_idx, split, seed, 60, N]) (N = 1e6 for variant b); in this order standard_normal(N) programming noise, standard_normal(N) drift-exponent noise, standard_normal((5, N)) read noise at the five E4 inference times; replicas programmed to 12.5 uS; estimator a_hat = mean G(t) / mean G right after programming (E4)

variants.a: E4 a_hat (64 replicas, E4 draws); condition all only
variants.b: large-sample limit a_inf (N = 1e6, same estimator); reference for added errors; condition unif: a_inf = a(t) exactly
variants.d: N replicas, new streams; condition all only

e52.added_error: per bound de = e(a_hat) - e(a_inf); added rms = rms of de over the bounds that are not bound failures under either factor
e52.gain_limit: per sign of g: |g| at which the added rms reaches 0.1 LSB, by linear interpolation of the added rms over |g| including (0, 0); beyond 5 % reported as > 5 %
e52.update_rule: staleness makes the applied factor too large (g > 0): updating whenever the replica estimate has fallen by the fraction r = g_max+ / (1 + g_max+) keeps g <= g_max+; updates in the first year = ceil(|ln a(1 y)| / -ln(1 - r)) with uniform drift nu = 0.049 from programming (a = 1) to 1 year

e53.dl_dac: read-time data-line voltages rounded to the nearest point of a uniform grid (threshold-verify voltages exact); grids: full (0 ... 1.8 V, step 1.8 / (2^b - 1)) and span (M(0) ... M(1) of the current input map, step (M(1) - M(0)) / (2^b - 1)), both continued beyond their ends with the same step (inputs in [0, 1] only use points inside; the continuation only defines the quantized bound of bounds outside the input range); lower bounds switch at V_g - step/2 with V_g the lowest grid point >= V*, upper bounds at V_g' + step/2 with V_g' the highest grid point <= V*
e53.sl_dac: supply node: one V_SL per branch type serves the whole array, so its rounding error is common to all bounds and moves through the whole interval as a_hat changes; evaluated at the worst case D_eff = D / a_hat +- step / 2 (both signs; the larger added rms counts), step = 1.8 / (2^b - 1); programming at V_sp,nom + D is a grid point (the same DAC sets V_SL during programming)
e53.added_error: per bound de = e(quantized) - e(exact) with the same draw; added rms over the bounds that are not bound failures

spot.role: independent re-check 2: quantized bound of 20 random bounds (dac_remap full and span grid, supply DAC)

e54.none: no compensation: the t0 setting (supplies V_sp,nom + D, input map M0) at the later time
e54.rng: programming noise and drift exponents (cells and replicas): the E4 draws; read noise at the 13 times: numpy.random.default_rng([base_seed, ds_idx, split, seed, 61]); in this order standard_normal((13, K)) for the cells and standard_normal((13, 64)) for the replicas
e54.time_to_budget: first evaluated time at which the metric exceeds the budget, interpolated linearly in log t between that time and the previous one; 'exceeded at t0' if the t0 value already exceeds it, '< 10 s' if 10 s does, '> 10 y' if no evaluated time does
e54.refresh: reprogramming (threshold verify of every cell) rate = 1 year / T_B, not rounded

checks.C1: full run only: E5.1 n and rms with bound failures (full set) equal E4 cell_errors.csv; n exact, rms relative difference <= 1e-9
checks.C2: full run only: E5.1 split 0, seed 0, condition all: n, bound failures, rms without them and median |e| equal E4 analysis_cell_errors_robust.csv; counts exact, values relative difference <= 1e-9
checks.C3: E5.3 without quantization equals the E4 bound of the same draw: max |de| <= 1e-12 LSB
checks.C4: E5.2 variant a (condition all) and g = 0 (condition unif) equal the E4 bound of the same draw: max |de| <= 1e-12 LSB
checks.C5: E5.4 at 1d, 30d, 1y (nodes dac_remap, supply, ideal): condition unif equals the E4 bound (max |de| <= 1e-12 LSB); condition all: rms without bound failures within 3 % of the E4-draw value of the same subset (read noise drawn anew)
checks.stop_rule: a failed check marks the run checks_failed; nothing is interpreted before the cause is found

smoke.note: program check only; outcomes not interpreted; C1 and C2 need the full set and are not evaluated

not_modelled: match-line crosstalk (acts on the row decision, not on a single bound; E4)
transistor-level circuits of the compensation (replica read-out, DAC, supply regulator), their area and energy
temperature dependence of PCM conductance and drift; programming and read at the same temperature
